en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a multi‑storey modernist commercial building with large windows and the word "STRÖMS" on the facade and on a rooftop flag. People in long coats walk along the cobbled street, and a tram is visible on the right. Leafless trees and street lamps line the street. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as Göteborg and the building as Strömska Huset.
